_milan_kvasnicka_: Viktor Kvasnicka arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a letter he never sent and a borrowed greatcoat two sizes too big.
Viktor Kvasnicka was in the first hundred. The old hands in R-F13 call them 'the early birds', and not always kindly.
Viktor Kvasnicka wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.
Viktor Kvasnicka counted the ladles in the pot against the men in the queue. The final serving took some careful scraping.

Viktor Kvasnicka began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else. Verdel Ridge is lost. Viktor Kvasnicka heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Word of Viktor Kvasnicka's blanket spread. A strip of lining and a square from an old scarf arrived without explanation.
The salvo walked along R-F13 and caught Viktor Kvasnicka in the open. Two men carried him back between salvos.

No bed for Viktor Kvasnicka yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up. News that the Hegemony had taken Hill 304 reached Viktor Kvasnicka during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
The medics would not give up on Viktor Kvasnicka. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to R-F13 today.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F13 and grazed Viktor Kvasnicka's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Felix Kagr of the Concord (@k4a.gr).
The medics cleaned Viktor Kvasnicka's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-F13.
Viktor Kvasnicka finished the blanket using six kinds of cloth. The men can identify most of the donors by the patches alone.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Viktor Kvasnicka was hit hard in the fight at R-F13 before anyone could fire. The raider was Gideon "Mole" Deale of the Concord. Raider: Gideon "Mole" Deale of the Concord (@richard.deale). Viktor Kvasnicka walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Viktor Kvasnicka's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Viktor Kvasnicka did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Viktor Kvasnicka across the shin at R-F13. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Arno "Mud" Bobkin of the Concord (@bob.bobkin.921).

A single shot from across the wire hit Viktor Kvasnicka in the thigh at R-F13. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Yann Liamroberts of the Concord (@liamroberts141). Viktor Kvasnicka was hit at R-F13 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Yann Liamroberts of the Concord (@liamroberts141).
The House of Kvasnicka sent Oskar "Ash" Kvasnicka after Viktor Kvasnicka. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
Oskar "Ash" Kvasnicka reads Tobias Deadeyesimul's letters from home out loud, because Tobias never learned to read. Ash leaves out the sad parts. Tobias knows.

A bullet clipped Oskar "Ash" Kvasnicka's helmet at R-F13 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Tobias "Ash" Alierayyagiy of the Concord (@alierayyagiyanik).

A bullet went through Oskar "Ash" Kvasnicka's upper arm at R-F13 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Bastian "Ghost" Charlesabate of the Concord (@_charlesabate_).
Oskar "Ash" Kvasnicka spent the day on a stretcher counting the bearers who went past. Forty-three. None of them stopped.
adam.reed.505523: Jonas Reed introduced himself as a railway porter from Old Harrow. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.

Jonas Reed pulled Felix Dougc out of a flooded shell hole at Saint-Ash crossroads. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember. A letter from home reached Jonas Reed before dusk. Jonas Reed read it twice and slept a little easier.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet grazed Jonas Reed's ribs at N-F11. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. A letter from home reached Jonas Reed before dusk. Jonas Reed read it twice and slept a little easier.

The medic cut the last bandage off Jonas Reed's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to N-F11 the same hour. A letter from home reached Jonas Reed before dusk. Jonas Reed read it twice and slept a little easier.

The rain did not stop once. Jonas Reed slept standing up, wedged against the wall of N-F11, and dreamt of dry socks. A thin letter reached Jonas Reed. Only five lines long, and Jonas Reed knew every one of them by heart before supper.

Jonas Reed cut his hand to the bone on the wire at Calvary Farm. Iodine, a bandage, and a lecture from the medic. Jonas Reed read the letter out loud to the squad, skipping the private parts. The men asked to hear it again.
camiloalmadalopez: Ivo "Bones" Camiloalmada unpacked a pocket Bible with a hole in it at N-F8. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Ivo "Bones" Camiloalmada wrote to a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
An empty jam tin became Ivo "Bones" Camiloalmada's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips.
A football came over the parapet from the Concord side with Ivo "Bones" Camiloalmada's name scratched on it. Gideon "Doc" Midnight kicked it back. It did not come again.

Ivo "Bones" Camiloalmada was hit in the hip at N-F8. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Jonas "Lucky" Zachbutler of the Hegemony (@zachbutler27). Dawn watch. Ivo "Bones" Camiloalmada put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Jonas "Lucky" Zachbutler, badly wounded. A single shot at N-F8. Ivo "Bones" Camiloalmada sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Jonas "Lucky" Zachbutler of the Hegemony (@zachbutler27).
Cyril "Tin" Camiloalmada put a pocket Bible with a hole in it beside the bunk. Someone who had known Ivo "Bones" Camiloalmada helped clear the shelf without saying why.

A bullet clipped Cyril "Tin" Camiloalmada's helmet at N-F8 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Tobias "Ash" Simsnichols of the Hegemony (@simsnichols).
Cyril "Tin" Camiloalmada no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Cyril "Tin" Camiloalmada washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation.
coletonmartin: Dorian Coletonmarti reported to S-F15 with a frozen apple sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Dorian Coletonmarti said yes, and was made to explain how anyone could tell.
After what happened at Verdel Ridge, Dorian Coletonmarti asked to serve as a sapper. Nobody argued.

The parcel for Dorian Coletonmarti contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade. Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Dorian Coletonmarti stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
A man asked Dorian Coletonmarti to describe Wyvern Cross without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.
Someone in S-F15 asked Dorian Coletonmarti about Wyvern Cross. He talked for an hour. Nobody interrupted.

Dorian Coletonmarti was hit through the chest at S-F15. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Edmund Owenhart of the Concord (@owenhart247). The bearers reached Dorian Coletonmarti at S-F15 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Edmund Owenhart of the Concord (@owenhart247).

Gustav Coletonmarti arrived carrying the family name of Dorian Coletonmarti. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer. The Hegemony secured Hill 304. Gustav Coletonmarti helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Gustav Coletonmarti tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread. The transfer made Gustav Coletonmarti a sapper. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.
Gustav Coletonmarti and Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Gustav Coletonmarti in the open at S-F15. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Edmund Owenhart of the Concord (@owenhart247). The orderlies scrubbed a bed in the hospital dugout and called for Gustav Coletonmarti. He was asleep before they set him down. Gustav Coletonmarti is out of the worst of it. He sleeps most of the day, and the surgeon lets him.

A surgeon stopped at Gustav Coletonmarti's bed, checked the dressing and moved on without a word. He decided that was good news. A letter from home reached Gustav Coletonmarti before dusk. Gustav Coletonmarti read it twice and slept a little easier.
Gustav Coletonmarti waited two nights for a bed. On the third, a bed came free, but Gustav Coletonmarti no longer needed it.

The papers connected Jonas "Rabbit" Coletonmarti to Gustav Coletonmarti. The men took longer to learn Jonas "Rabbit" Coletonmarti's own habits, but they made the effort. Jonas "Rabbit" Coletonmarti asked to leave the stretcher bearers and serve as a rifleman. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.

Jonas "Rabbit" Coletonmarti rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Matthias "Tin" Wwjd was grazed at the far edge of no man's land. Jonas "Rabbit" Coletonmarti got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 107. The men who came later will ask about it. Victory at Grey Mill. Jonas "Rabbit" Coletonmarti let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Fresh from training, Jonas "Rabbit" Coletonmarti still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Karel Stefan, grazed.
Jonas "Rabbit" Coletonmarti polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too.

Jonas "Rabbit" Coletonmarti gave Ulrich "Mud" Potato the last match in the trench. Mud used it to light a candle so that Rabbit could finish a letter. A letter from home reached Jonas "Rabbit" Coletonmarti before dusk. Jonas "Rabbit" Coletonmarti read it twice and slept a little easier.

A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Jonas "Rabbit" Coletonmarti across the shin at S-F15. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman of the Concord (@killerdogman2010).
Jonas "Rabbit" Coletonmarti returned to S-F15 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.

Jonas "Rabbit" Coletonmarti fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Isidor Eccentricred, gravely wounded. Nobody nearby said anything. A bullet hit Jonas "Rabbit" Coletonmarti in the neck at S-F15. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Bastian Ronne of the Concord (@ronne_02). Jonas "Rabbit" Coletonmarti looked over the parapet at S-F15 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Bastian Ronne of the Concord (@ronne_02).
Dorian "Lucky" Coletonmarti put a frozen apple beside the bunk. Someone who had known Jonas "Rabbit" Coletonmarti helped clear the shelf without saying why.
gethectoredbruh: Roland Gethectoredb, a farmhand from Varenne, was sent forward on Day 10 to fill a gap in T-F16. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

Roland Gethectoredb fired at the enemy dawn watch from T-F16. Teodor Pentacatholi was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down. A letter from home found Roland Gethectoredb before the night shift. Roland Gethectoredb folded it small and kept it close. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Roland Gethectoredb helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Roland Gethectoredb brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived. A letter from home found Roland Gethectoredb before the night shift. Roland Gethectoredb folded it small and kept it close.

Roland Gethectoredb had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Roland Ryann was grazed. A letter from home found Roland Gethectoredb before the night shift. Roland Gethectoredb folded it small and kept it close.

The east wind brought the smell of the other trenches: smoke, lime and somebody's cooking. Roland Gethectoredb was hungry and furious about it. A letter from home found Roland Gethectoredb before the night shift. Roland Gethectoredb folded it small and kept it close.

A man asked Roland Gethectoredb to describe Varenne without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch. A letter from home found Roland Gethectoredb before the night shift. Roland Gethectoredb folded it small and kept it close.

Roland Gethectoredb went over with the night raiders, found the enemy trench empty at that spot, and came back with a bag of their biscuits. Roland Gethectoredb got a letter today. The handwriting was shaky, but the news was good. The letter went inside the helmet, for luck.

Roland Gethectoredb of the Hegemony shouted across the wire at Grey Mill, asking for the football scores from home. Teodor Taylocirapto of the Concord shouted them back. Some of them were even true. A letter for Roland Gethectoredb came with a pressed flower inside. Roland Gethectoredb showed the flower to nobody.
him_scotland: Felix Scotland took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Felix Scotland fished it out by feel and then had to wash again.

The Concord raiders came over at N-F16 in the middle of the night. Felix Scotland met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Bastian "Mud" Bnfts of the Concord (@b3n3f1ts).
Hugo Scotland had heard about Felix Scotland's courage. At N-F16, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

A bullet went through Hugo Scotland's upper arm at N-F16 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Roland Dav of the Concord (@dav.cl_). The beds were full. Hugo Scotland waits on a stretcher in the dark with a medic's promise and a dry mouth.
jamesbertin1cor13: The sergeant gave Albin Cor a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 13 or any other.

Albin Cor and Konrad Xxcboogxx found a cat in the ruins at the Hanging Bridge and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Konrad. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Cor. Albin Cor read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Albin Cor gave Emil Hartilllondo the last match in the trench. Emil used it to light a candle so that Albin could finish a letter. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Cor. Albin Cor read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
The Hegemony raiders came over at V-F20 in the middle of the night. Albin Cor met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Viktor Gunny of the Hegemony (@gunny1717).
Another member of the House of Cor reached the line: Florian Cor. He asked where Albin Cor had slept, then chose a different corner.
The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Florian Cor asked to see the second one. The barber laughed. Florian Cor got a letter with a pressed leaf from the tree by the front door at home.
lachlan_0706: The sergeant gave Benedikt "Lucky" Lachlan a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 10 or any other.

Benedikt "Lucky" Lachlan tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into U-F3. Benedikt "Lucky" Lachlan has learned to walk bent double.
Benedikt "Lucky" Lachlan tried to fold a frozen groundsheet. It objected loudly enough to wake the next sleeper.
Benedikt "Lucky" Lachlan borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing.
Someone in U-F3 asked Benedikt "Lucky" Lachlan about Varenne. He talked for an hour. Nobody interrupted.
Benedikt "Lucky" Lachlan has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Felix "Mud" Goat, grazed.
Benedikt "Lucky" Lachlan has asked three carrying parties for the next instalment. So far, the search has produced racing results and an advertisement for boots.
Benedikt "Lucky" Lachlan borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Felix "Mud" Goat was badly wounded.
matty_wrld: "You're late," said the corporal when Teodor Wrld arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Teodor Wrld stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores. A letter from home found Teodor Wrld before the night shift. Teodor Wrld folded it small and kept it close.

Teodor Wrld made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration. A letter from home found Teodor Wrld before the night shift. Teodor Wrld folded it small and kept it close. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached Q-F3 with the rations. Teodor Wrld ate while listening to the revised orders.

Teodor Wrld reads Rafael Grenades's letters from home out loud, because Rafael never learned to read. Teodor leaves out the sad parts. Rafael knows. A letter from home found Teodor Wrld before the night shift. Teodor Wrld folded it small and kept it close.
Teodor Wrld saw a hare run the whole length of no man's land and nobody on either side fired at it.
Teodor Wrld checked the fire step after the shelling. The wall had moved, and the spot where he always put his foot was gone.
Teodor Wrld washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation.
Teodor Wrld snores. Arno Ldscheffelma does not. Arno now sleeps with a sock stuffed in each ear, and the two are still friends.
Teodor Wrld traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch.
mister_clear_d: Ulrich "Parson" Clear unpacked a lucky button at N-F3. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Ulrich "Parson" Clear lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing.
Ulrich "Parson" Clear and Karel "Brick" Jarnvag sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.
The storm put out the lamp twice. On the third attempt, Ulrich "Parson" Clear and two others formed a very irritated windbreak.
Ulrich "Parson" Clear counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Isidor Lee was badly wounded.
Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Ulrich "Parson" Clear went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin.
mr_4ndersen: On Day 13, Severin Ndersen arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Severin Ndersen tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at N-F2 is up.
Severin Ndersen lent Walter Maccario a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg.

Severin Ndersen went over the top with the night raiders, face black with soot. In the Hegemony trench a man turned around too late. Arno Evan did not get up again. (@masudkainath_evan) In the dark of the Hegemony trench Severin Ndersen hit Matthias Shannen with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@dawn.shannen27) Severin Ndersen's transfer to the role of sniper was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.
Severin Ndersen was made Lance Corporal. He celebrated by sleeping four hours in a row.
nalabrad: "You're late," said the corporal when Quentin "Shadow" Nalabrad arrived on Day 14. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

Quentin "Shadow" Nalabrad checked the safety catch three times before handing over the post. The man taking over noticed, and checked it once more. A letter from home found Quentin "Shadow" Nalabrad before the night shift. Quentin "Shadow" Nalabrad folded it small and kept it close.

No rifles, only shovels and knives. Quentin "Shadow" Nalabrad dropped into the Concord trench by a dugout door and met Viktor Fluffybaldy coming out. It was over in seconds. (@fluffybaldy) The flare went up just as Quentin "Shadow" Nalabrad reached the Concord parapet. Quentin "Shadow" Nalabrad jumped down first. Bastian Lbz was the man waiting there, and Bastian Lbz fell. (@lbz.z1p) The censor had blacked out two words in the letter for Quentin "Shadow" Nalabrad. Quentin "Shadow" Nalabrad guessed what they were and laughed.
A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Quentin "Shadow" Nalabrad's bunk. He has named it Captain.
norcalz: Clement "Ash" Norcalz arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a letter he never sent and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

Clement "Ash" Norcalz opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first. A letter from home found Clement "Ash" Norcalz before the night shift. Clement "Ash" Norcalz folded it small and kept it close. Grey Mill is lost. Clement "Ash" Norcalz heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Someone asked Clement "Ash" Norcalz to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten. A letter from home found Clement "Ash" Norcalz before the night shift. Clement "Ash" Norcalz folded it small and kept it close.

A familiar voice came out of the fog in the wrong direction. Clement "Ash" Norcalz waited for the password before answering. A letter from home found Clement "Ash" Norcalz before the night shift. Clement "Ash" Norcalz folded it small and kept it close.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Clement "Ash" Norcalz raised his head for a heartbeat too long at P-F8. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. A letter from home found Clement "Ash" Norcalz before the night shift. Clement "Ash" Norcalz folded it small and kept it close.

Three days with a bandage, and Clement "Ash" Norcalz is back at P-F8. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him. A letter from home found Clement "Ash" Norcalz before the night shift. Clement "Ash" Norcalz folded it small and kept it close.

Clement "Ash" Norcalz was on the dawn watch at P-F8 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Clement "Ash" Norcalz was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Cyril "Mole" Korathon of the Hegemony (@korathon1). Clement "Ash" Norcalz made it into the enemy trench and out again, but a machine gun swept no man's land on the way home. Clement "Ash" Norcalz crawled the last yards. There was a letter for Clement "Ash" Norcalz and a little tobacco folded inside. The tobacco went round the squad. The letter did not.

The wound on Clement "Ash" Norcalz's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter. The letter for Clement "Ash" Norcalz asked if the food was good. Clement "Ash" Norcalz wrote back that it was. That was a lie, but a kind one.
ootrumhellfish: Yann Ootrumhellfi came from Millbank, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.

Yann Ootrumhellfi and Pavel Vinsaint share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship. Mail came up the line with a letter for Yann Ootrumhellfi. Yann Ootrumhellfi read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Yann Ootrumhellfi found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'. Mail came up the line with a letter for Yann Ootrumhellfi. Yann Ootrumhellfi read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
A shell hit the latrine at N-F20. Nobody was hurt. Yann Ootrumhellfi says it was the best day of the war.

Water rose to the second step of the dugout. Yann Ootrumhellfi moved a lucky button to the highest shelf and sat beside it like a guard. A letter came for Yann Ootrumhellfi with a sketch of the kitchen at home. Yann Ootrumhellfi pinned it to the dugout wall.

Yann Ootrumhellfi's menu now circulates before supper. Someone has requested a wine list. The water bucket has been given a vintage. The letter for Yann Ootrumhellfi smelled faintly of soap. Yann Ootrumhellfi held it close for a long time before opening it.
rares.dmt_: Henrik Dmt introduced himself as a medical student from Marrow Fen. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
Henrik Dmt and Clement "Saint" Jozsef found a cat in the ruins at the Drowned Farm and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Saint.
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Henrik Dmt shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Henrik Dmt smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Henrik Guacamole came out for a cup and was grazed. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Henrik Dmt answered to number 530. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Henrik Dmt helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Henrik Dmt was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Dorian "Ash" Juanito was grazed. A bullet hit the sandbag next to Henrik Dmt's ear at S-S3 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Zeno "Shadow" Mw of the Concord (@m.w_1254).
The medics cleaned Henrik Dmt's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-S3.
A shell landed close to S-S3. When the dust settled Henrik Dmt was still there, holding a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts, laughing without sound.

Henrik Dmt borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Zeno "Shadow" Mw was grazed. Henrik Dmt was hit in the hip at S-S3. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Rafael Carwyn of the Concord (@carwyn1988). Henrik Dmt was hit at S-S3 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Rafael Carwyn of the Concord (@carwyn1988).
The papers say Roland "Hollow" Dmt. The sergeant says he has his uncle's eyes. Henrik Dmt's eyes. Nobody in S-S3 argues.

Roland "Hollow" Dmt was hit in the forearm at S-S3. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Pavel Saturdaynigh of the Concord (@saturdaynightinafieldrunning).
Three days with a bandage, and Roland "Hollow" Dmt is back at S-S3. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
ripvanwinkle3031: Nobody asked Dietrich Ripvanwinkle why he came. Nobody in R-S2 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
A loose thread in Dietrich Ripvanwinkle's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain.

The Hegemony sentry, Zeno Helldiver, shouted once. Dietrich Ripvanwinkle silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@some_random_helldiver) Dietrich Ripvanwinkle joined the raid, lay in a shell hole for an hour while the flares burned, and made it home. That counts as a good night out here. After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Dietrich Ripvanwinkle helped stack spare sandbags at R-S2. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Dietrich Ripvanwinkle drew the counter-mine plans by candlelight. Below the Ossuary Wood the earth is now a maze, and he knows every turn. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Dietrich Ripvanwinkle answered to number 570. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Dietrich Ripvanwinkle wrote to a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Dietrich Ripvanwinkle writes everything down in a tiny notebook. Today, under fire at the Chalk Pits, that habit was the only steady thing in R-S2.
Dietrich Ripvanwinkle traded a book with the last pages torn out for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it.
Dietrich Ripvanwinkle measured a replacement beam three times in the narrow passage. Nobody wanted to be the one who got it wrong.
A football came over the parapet from the Hegemony side with Clement List's name scratched on it. Dietrich Ripvanwinkle kicked it back. It did not come again.
Dietrich Ripvanwinkle caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again.
A bullet went through Dietrich Ripvanwinkle's sleeve at R-S2 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Silas Paulus of the Hegemony (@chen_paulus11).
schmidty_1013: The new rifleman gave his name as Rafael Schmidty. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.

The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Rafael Schmidty helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly. Now serving as a sapper, Rafael Schmidty discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.

Rafael Schmidty was sent to examine a pump that worked only when struck. He asked the men to stop striking it long enough to listen. A letter from home found Rafael Schmidty before the night shift. Rafael Schmidty folded it small and kept it close. The clerk counted the names twice. Rafael Schmidty is number 953 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Rafael Schmidty folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
The pump's fault proved to be a worn fitting. Rafael Schmidty made a replacement from scrap while the men returned to bailing by hand.
Rafael Schmidty's replacement fitting held, but the intake kept clogging. He fitted a rough screen and stayed through a full shift to watch it.
Rafael Schmidty spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides.
The pump ran without help. Rafael Schmidty left a short maintenance note and took away the hammer everyone had been using on it.
A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Rafael Schmidty as a story about a general. The ending was the same.
Rafael Schmidty and Tobias Padraiggalla divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.
t.0uj0: Nils Tuj left an old father who runs the family shop alone behind in Rosenau and came up the line with his brother's pocket watch. The men noticed at once that he counts everything: steps, shells, stars.

On a quiet night Nils Tuj (Concord) and Edmund Dreamskyi (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there. Mail came up the line with a letter for Nils Tuj. Nils Tuj read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Nils Tuj kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Nils Tuj fired at the enemy dawn watch from P-F7. Gustav Bobopomaranc was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down. Mail came up the line with a letter for Nils Tuj. Nils Tuj read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Someone asked Nils Tuj to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten. Mail came up the line with a letter for Nils Tuj. Nils Tuj read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Nils Tuj snores. Otto Benryderfitz does not. Otto now sleeps with a sock stuffed in each ear, and the two are still friends.
New laces made Nils Tuj's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up.
Back from the raid, Nils Tuj found a sweetheart card in a coat pocket that was not there before: 'Seaside' (common). Nobody asked where it came from.
Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Nils Tuj read a theatre review while peeling supper.
the_foticus: On Day 7 Norbert Foticus took a post at S-S4 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He writes everything down in a tiny notebook, and the men liked him for it.
Norbert Foticus found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot.
Norbert Foticus saw a hare run the whole length of no man's land and nobody on either side fired at it.
Victory at Blackwater Canal. Norbert Foticus let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Norbert Foticus brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived. Norbert Foticus got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 495. The men who came later will ask about it. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Norbert Foticus during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
A shell hit the latrine at S-S4. Nobody was hurt. Norbert Foticus says it was the best day of the war.
Norbert Foticus tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread.
A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Norbert Foticus lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing.
A rat stole Norbert Foticus's cheese ration while he watched. He let it. The rat looked hungrier.
Norbert Foticus fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Clement Majormalprac, badly wounded.
Hugo "Tin" Ngaihte and Norbert Foticus compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
thinn_rg: They issued Jakub Thinn a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a letter he never sent in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Jakub Thinn. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.
Jakub Thinn reached up to fix a sandbag at N-F11 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Ulrich Redner of the Concord (@vance_redner).
Three days with a bandage, and Jakub Thinn is back at N-F11. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
At N-F11 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Jakub Thinn turned around and took a shovel blow. Hugo Dbd of the Concord was already gone. Raider: Hugo Dbd of the Concord (@florian_dbd).
There were too few medics and too many wounded. Jakub Thinn waited too long, and the wound grew worse for it.
trentonpayne2: The draft reached M-F16 on Day 15. Norbert "Hollow" Trentonpayne was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
The section held a competition for the worst joke. Norbert "Hollow" Trentonpayne won before reaching the end of his entry.
Norbert "Hollow" Trentonpayne found a flower growing out of a sandbag. He did not tell anyone. He checks on it every morning.
williemcminn7022: Nobody saw Walter "Saint" Williemcminn arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in Q-F10, and a quiet rifleman under it.

Walter "Saint" Williemcminn was hit in the forearm at Q-F10. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Konrad "Mud" Pawington of the Hegemony (@comrade_pawington). From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Walter "Saint" Williemcminn wrote to his mother, who writes every Sunday that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

The medic looked at Walter "Saint" Williemcminn's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to Q-F10. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Walter "Saint" Williemcminn stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Albin Prokes had Walter "Saint" Williemcminn of the Concord in the sights at Blackwater Canal for a long second. Walter "Saint" Williemcminn was lighting a pipe. Albin Prokes let the match burn all the way down.
Walter "Saint" Williemcminn dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it.
Walter "Saint" Williemcminn got a letter from Anna. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.
Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Walter "Saint" Williemcminn read a theatre review while peeling supper.
Walter "Saint" Williemcminn wrote back to Anna and tore it up three times. The fourth version says almost nothing, which is how he knows it is the right one.
Walter "Saint" Williemcminn fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Gustav "Ash" Chickenman, badly wounded. Nobody nearby said anything.
yoollyfox: Bram Yoollyfox arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a pressed cornflower and a borrowed greatcoat two sizes too big.
The first hundred were recognised, and Bram Yoollyfox was among them. He wrote the news on the back of an unfinished letter.
The sergeant read out the order: Verdel Ridge has fallen, hold the line. Bram Yoollyfox looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A shell landed square in R-F9. They found Bram Yoollyfox alive under the sandbags, barely. Every minute counts now. The surgeon worked on Bram Yoollyfox until the lamp ran dry. It was not enough.

The House of Yoollyfox sent another. Dorian Yoollyfox, older brother of Bram Yoollyfox, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence. First Wave. Dorian Yoollyfox signed when the ink on the posters was still fresh. He keeps the ribbon wrapped in oilcloth with a pressed cornflower.
Dorian Yoollyfox got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.

Dorian Yoollyfox measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together. Dorian Yoollyfox walked the captured trenches of Hill 304 and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Dorian Yoollyfox traded a cigarette for a pinch of salt. Supper improved. The argument about the exchange rate did not.
Dorian Yoollyfox tried to sketch a horse from memory. The dugout agreed it was a very good dog.
Dorian Yoollyfox fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Jonas Steini was badly wounded, and that rifle did not fire again tonight.
Dorian Yoollyfox saved a seat for someone fetching supper. Holding it against three hungry men turned out to be hard work.
News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Dorian Yoollyfox during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Dorian Yoollyfox fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Bram Freddie, badly wounded. Dorian Yoollyfox fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Clement Glubtupuswhe was gravely wounded. Dorian Yoollyfox ate breakfast without a word. Grey Mill has been won. Dorian Yoollyfox listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Dorian Yoollyfox remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped.
On dawn watch at R-F9, Dorian Yoollyfox fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Dorian Shpkunky, now grazed.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Dorian Yoollyfox in the open at R-F9. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Ivo "Mud" Samwade of the Concord (@its.samwade). The bearers reached Dorian Yoollyfox at R-F9 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Ivo "Mud" Samwade of the Concord (@its.samwade).
Dietrich Yoollyfox put a pressed cornflower beside the bunk. Someone who had known Dorian Yoollyfox helped clear the shelf without saying why.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Dietrich Yoollyfox's ear at R-F9 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Hugo Rock of the Concord (@rotrek_rock).
Dietrich Yoollyfox's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
Dietrich Yoollyfox fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Konrad Daami was badly wounded.
